lines.en: Oh, you don't have an umbrella? I have a spare one in my locker—want me to lend it to you?

items.questionJp: いちばんいい返事[へんじ]はどれですか。
choices: えっ、本当[ほんとう]？助[たす]かるよ、明日[あした]必[かなら]ず返[かえ]すね。
うん、傘[かさ]を貸[か]してあげるよ。

items.explanationEn: Option 1 gratefully accepts the offer ("助かるよ") and promises to return it tomorrow. Option 2 reverses the giver/receiver ("貸してあげる").

items.situationEn: A student asks a club organizer how to join weekly language exchange meetings.

items.introEn: A male student and female student are talking at university. What will the male student do first?

lines.en: I'm interested in the international exchange club. You meet every Wednesday, right?

lines.en: Yes, that's right! Just observing at first is totally welcome too.

lines.en: Can I just show up? Is a membership fee required?

lines.jp: 会費[かいひ]は正式[せいしき]に入[はい]る時[とき]だけで大丈夫[だいじょうぶ]です。ただ、部屋[へや]の人数[にんずう]制限[せいげん]があるので、来[く]る前日[ぜんじつ]までにサークルのSNSへメッセージを送[おく]っておいてください。
lines.en: The fee is only when you officially join. However, because of room capacity limits, please send a message to the club's social media by the day before you come.

items.questionJp: 男[おとこ]の学生[がくせい]が見学[けんがく]に行[い]く前[まえ]にすることは何[なん]ですか。

choices: 会費[かいひ]を先[さき]に払[はら]う
前日[ぜんじつ]までにサークルのSNSへメッセージを送[おく]る

choicesEn: Pay the membership fee in advance
Send a message to the club's social media by the day before
Submit a membership form to the office
Take an English test
items.explanationEn: No fee is needed just to observe, but due to room limits he must message the club's SNS by the day before.
